Practical application
If one wants a person to look younger, cool, dark colours should be used. Light colours
make a person look older. Dark colours lend youthfulness to a personality.
Colours according to seasons
Effect of temperature, effect oflight colours, effect of extreme temperature.
I
White - white colour reflects light colours
Black - absorbs light colours.
Light colours are cooler and more comfortable to wear in summers when temperatures
are high. This is because dark colours absorb light. It also matches the skin colour.
On the other hand, white reflects light colours and enhances the colour scheme and also
helps in changing it. In this way, you have seen how colour harmony and contrasting are
important in designing. They help us in making the garments beautiful and attractive.
